_about: Human-in-the-loop layer: disputes the verifier raised (or created) that were settled by reading the vendor's own page in a browser. Applied on top of v2 to produce data/final. Each entry records who was right.

set.mcp_note: twilio-labs/mcp (@twilio-alpha/mcp) exposes all of Twilio's public APIs as MCP tools; Twilio calls it one of 'our official' servers. The separate twilio.com/docs/ai/mcp server is docs-search only.

22.verdict_on_dispute: v1 right, verifier wrong: verifier saw only the docs-search MCP and downgraded to community.

set.access_notes: Aura Free tier can create Aura API client credentials (OAuth2 client-credentials); no card needed for API credentials.
set.blocker_note: Aura API manages instances only; graph data goes through each instance's Query API/drivers.

66.verdict_on_dispute: v1 right, verifier wrong: docs state 'All tiers can create Aura API credentials'; verifier changed it to paid_plan_required.

29.verdict_on_dispute: Vendor sources conflict: support.aircall.io documents an official MCP (read-only beta via Account Manager) while developer.aircall.io/docs/mcp-faqs says Aircall offers no MCP server. Kept 'official' (the beta article is newer and specific); flagged as a real conflict.
